_note: Each theme describes a look in our own words. Prompts never name the decks or artists that inspired them; `inspiredBy` / `inspiredArtist` are only shown on the site as credit.

themes.name: Ember & Ivory
themes.blurb: Porcelain figures floating in black space, lit by molten gold and drifting embers.
themes.style: Matte pure-black background with generous empty black space. One central subject floating mid-card under a soft overhead spotlight, with a faint oval pool of light beneath it. Figures and animals are smooth porcelain-white and sculptural, faces masked, serene or turned away. Rich molten gold and amber supply all the colour: glowing embers, drifting gold sparks, gold-leaf discs, warm firelight, glass vessels catching golden light. Soft cinematic lighting, painterly 3D digital rendering, high contrast, minimal, quiet and elegant.
themes.composition: A minimal symbolic reinterpretation with one central subject; drop background scenery and keep only the essential figures and symbols floating in the black space.

themes.name: Golden Hour
themes.blurb: Warm, sunlit painterly scenes of modern people, full of glow and texture.
themes.style: Warm painterly digital illustration bathed in late-afternoon golden light, with soft lens glow and visible brush texture. Diverse contemporary people with bohemian, earthy clothing, flowing hair and expressive gestures. Palette of honey, peach, terracotta, sage and dusky lilac with luminous highlights. Dreamy, intimate, grounded and hopeful, with subtle sparkle and natural textures (linen, plants, skin, stone).
themes.composition: A full scene with one or two people in a natural or home setting; keep the traditional meaning and key symbols but in a present-day world.

themes.name: Aeon Geometry
themes.inspiredArtist: Aleister Crowley and Lady Frieda Harris
themes.blurb: Art Deco geometry, radiating abstract forms and jewel colours steeped in alchemy.
themes.style: Esoteric Art Deco painting built from projective geometry: radiating rays, interlocking arcs, crystalline facets and overlapping translucent planes. Saturated jewel colours (emerald, sapphire, crimson, saffron, violet) shading into each other. Egyptian, alchemical and astrological motifs. Figures are stylised and statuesque, partly dissolved into the geometry. Visionary, intense, symmetrical, gouache-and-watercolour texture.
themes.composition: A symmetrical, emblematic composition centred on the main figure or symbol, with geometric energy radiating outward to the edges.

pentacles: spinning disk with a five-pointed star at its hub
spinning disks with a five-pointed star at the hub

themes.rules: Thin black border around the whole image.

themes.name: Crystal Dream
themes.blurb: Glowing fantasy painting of crystal, ice and starlight in blues and violets.
themes.style: Luminous fantasy digital painting. Ethereal figures with long flowing hair and gowns, delicate features, glowing skin. Crystal, ice, quartz and starlight everywhere, with soft bloom and sparkling light. Palette of icy blue, violet, silver, pale rose and moonlit white. Enchanted, otherworldly, fairy-tale atmosphere, highly detailed.
themes.composition: A full fantasy scene based on the traditional card, set in an enchanted crystalline world.

themes.name: Moonfaced
themes.blurb: Surreal gothic figures with crescent-moon faces in a muted, collaged dream world.
themes.style: Surreal gothic illustration with a hand-made digital collage feel. Elongated, stylised figures with pale crescent-moon-shaped mask faces, stitched and patched clothing, odd jointed limbs. Muted palette of slate grey, olive, bone white, dusty teal and rust, under a night sky. Backdrops of crooked towers, graveyards, carnival and asylum architecture. Eerie, whimsical, theatrical, with textured paper and weathered surfaces.
themes.composition: A theatrical full scene based on the traditional card, staged like a strange puppet play.

themes.name: Ink & Animal
themes.blurb: Sparse hand-drawn ink with animals in place of people and small washes of rainbow colour.
themes.style: Hand-drawn black ink illustration with fine, slightly imperfect pen lines and hatching on a plain off-white paper background. Lots of empty white space. People are replaced by animals and plants. Colour is used very sparingly: small soft washes of rainbow watercolour on one or two elements only. Simple, primal, raw and intimate.
themes.composition: A single central animal, object or natural form that symbolises the card; no human figures.

themes.name: City Coven
themes.blurb: Flat contemporary fashion illustration of diverse modern women in everyday city life.
themes.style: Contemporary flat vector fashion illustration with clean outlines and smooth gradients. Diverse modern women with stylish streetwear, tattoos, sneakers, phones, headphones and houseplants, in apartments, cafes, rooftops and city streets. Bright, saturated palette of hot pink, teal, coral, lavender and sunny yellow. Confident, playful, warm and inclusive.
themes.composition: A full present-day scene that translates the traditional card into everyday city life, keeping its key symbols.

themes.name: Line & Gold
themes.blurb: Minimal geometric line symbols in black, white and gold.
themes.style: Minimal flat geometric line art. Thin, even gold and black lines on a clean white background, built from circles, arcs, triangles and simple icons. No shading, no texture, no realistic people. Elegant, modern, calm and highly symbolic, like a refined icon set.
themes.composition: One simple central emblem made from the card's key symbols, arranged symmetrically.
